item.title: Tea Tree Oil 101: The Safe Way To Use It On Skin
item.description: Tea tree oil has a reputation for potency. What it lacks is a reputation for restraint. That contrast explains why it should never be applied straight from the bottle. In its pure form, tea tree oil is highly concentrated. The same antimicrobial strength that helps reduce acne-causing bacteria can also overwhelm the skin’s surface.
